head: cloud/completion-cache-prompt
title: fix(serve): honor cache_prompt on raw completion routes
body:
`/v1/completions` and `/completion` accepted `cache_prompt` and ignored it: the raw-prompt paths always submitted `cache_prompt = true` to the scheduler. I noted this as a follow-up in #548. This PR applies the field on those two routes the same way Chat Completions and Responses already do. `cache_prompt: false` bypasses memory and disk lookup for that request, and the result can still populate the cache. The default stays `true`, as in llama-server.

Changes:
- `http_server.cpp`: both raw completion handlers read `cache_prompt` and reject a non-boolean value with the existing compatibility 400 (`'cache_prompt' must be a boolean`).
- `TextGenerationBackend::complete` and `start_complete` take a trailing `bool cache_prompt = true`. The deferred default request forwards it.
- `InferenceBackend::complete` and `start_complete` pass it to the scheduler's `TextRequestMetadata` instead of a hard-coded `true`.
- `docs/SERVER.md` and `docs/KV-CACHE.md` now list all four routes.
- `http_server_test`: new `TestRawCompletionCachePrompt` covers both routes. It checks that `false`, omitted and `true` reach the backend, and that `null`, `"false"` and `0` return 400 without calling the backend. The test backends' overrides take the new parameter.

`/v1/messages` still ignores `cache_prompt`. It is not part of the Anthropic API and is left out here.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending. The `ENGINE_ENABLE_HIP` branches of `InferenceBackend` were not compiled here, so the gfx1151 build and a raw-completion request with `cache_prompt: false` (expect no `cache=` hit in the log) still need checking on hardware.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope, on an x86-64 CPU host (Ubuntu 24.04, GCC 13.3, `cpu-test` preset, HIP off):
- `cmake --build --preset pr` built the CPU targets and ran the hosted contract suite: 56/56 tests passed, including `http_server_test` and `openai_chat_test`.
- `python3 tools/ci/check-format.py` passed with clang-format 21, the version under which `main` checks clean (564 C++ files).
- `python3 tools/ci/check-docs.py` passed, and `tools/ci/check-pr-title.py` accepted the title.
- No GPU, model or functional tests ran.
